gui_parameter_preset_name_message: Enter a name for this preset.
gui_parameter_preset_last_error: The last preset cannot be deleted.
gui_param_help_max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens generated in one response. Lower values produce shorter responses; higher values allow longer ones.
gui_param_help_temperature: Controls output randomness. Lower values tend to produce more predictable, stable text; higher values tend to produce more varied text.
gui_param_help_top_p: Chooses the next token from candidates whose cumulative probability reaches this value. Lower values narrow the candidate set.
gui_param_help_top_k: Limits next-token choices to this many of the most likely candidates. A value of 0 disables this limit.
gui_param_help_presence_penalty: Penalizes using words that have already appeared. Positive values encourage new words; negative values favor previously used words.
gui_param_help_frequency_penalty: Discourages reuse according to how often a word has appeared. Higher positive values reduce repeated words.
gui_param_help_repetition_penalty: Adjusts reuse of previous tokens. 1 is neutral, values above 1 discourage repetition, and values below 1 encourage it.
gui_param_help_seed: Initial value for random generation. Reusing a value with the same model and settings can make results reproducible. -1 selects it automatically.
gui_param_help_stop: Generation stops when one of these strings appears in the output. Enter one string per line.
